column3: We hope to be developing the new Byxbysion Ward within the next couple years!
Around this time we also hope to reestablish rail access with the Orre Region.
All of this could not be possible without your support.
From myself and all of Reborn, thank you.
You wanna know something, buddy? I'll tell you a secret.
The lake water's too toxic to fish in, but my buddy's got this swimmin' pool in his house.
When the Pokémon in Azurine Lake started gettin' sick, he rescued a few of them and kept them in his swimming pool.
Now the place is practically like an aquarium!
I heard there's a whole secret area under the Grand Stairway.
But how could that be?
My buddy used to keep a private aquarium. He was super guarded about it, only letting certain people through.
But now that the water's clean again, he released all of those Pokémon back into the lake!
What's more, I managed to convince him to turn his tank into a public pool! How sweet is that, eh?
Isn't it hard to keep track of stat stages all the time?
But you can press Control in battle to toggle a view of everyone's current stages!
Not enough info? How about this? Try pressing Q or W in battle to inspect Pokémon on your side or the opponent's side. You'll get all the info you need!
Nifty, huh?
There's an old Abandoned Power Plant up north...
I hear kids disappear when it's windy, and show up there.
Weird, right?
So many strange things have been happening...
Howdy, Trainer.
You ain't come at the best time.
Once upon a time, Reborn was an oasis in the desert.
But then, alla this city sprung up, and the waste from it...
And then what ya see is what ya got.
You take care travelin' around here, all right?
Rumor has it that there was once an old region on the edge of Reborn, but now it's fallen into decay...
Boy howdy, I'll tell you what for.
I said once this place was an oasis in a desert, and I'm mighty glad that it's startin' to feel like that again.
I came here because I heard there was a League, but it's so poorly organized.
I've been trying to contact a certain Gym Leader for weeks, but his caretaker won't let him battle apparently...
\GSALESMAN: You're back! So, are you ready to claim this fantastic Pokémon for only $500?!
SALESMAN: Looking for more Pokémon? Of course you are! Well, then have I got a deal for you!
How would you like to be the proud new owner of one fantastic beast?
This Pokémon is so powerful, so utterly BAD-ASS, it's been heralded among dragons for centuries!
For you, I'll make a special discount, bringing the price down to only $500!
\GWhat do you say?!
Aha! Thank you! Thank you!
GOON: Heh. Bad-ass, you say?
Not a bad deal. I think I'll just help myself.
The Pokémon was stolen!
GOON: See ya, nerds!
SALESMAN: ...Well, I got my money. That's your problem now!
JERK: See ya, nerds!
SALESMAN: Buuuut, if you really wanted to get that ultra-rare Pokémon, you could try and find that guy.
Thugs like him hang out at the end of the tracks in the Peridot Ward. Good luck!
Hm? You don't have the money, my friend! Come back when you've got it! I'll be waiting!
Hey, you're missing out here!
We sometimes have some battle enthusiasts over here.
Different one every day of the week, and we get an extra turnout on weekends.
You can battle 'em as much as you want.
But we ask them to clear out when new Trainers come by.
We don't want some over-zealous 10 year old rocking up with their level 5 starter, nothing else, and proceeding to conk out on the first guy they see.
The free battle trainers will be back in a bit though; don't you worry.
...What, did you forget what I said about the free battle trainers being cleared out?
Or are you talking to me because you want me to bring them in early?
I mean... I can do that, if you really want.
Their teams are only a little bit above level 10 or so, so it's not too bad...
Should I tell them they can come in?
...Well, okay. If you're sure.
But don't blame us if you charge in there without being ready, all right?
All right. You hang tight.
That's probably a fair choice.
Just wait a little bit. They'll show up around the time you're hitting over that level.
Oh.
You must be wondering what happened to the rebattleable Trainers.
That's fair.
They all perished in the version update.
Terrible incident, really.
It's okay though, let me just use some necromancy to bring them back.
Good bye.
Oh? You seem to be doing quite well!
But are you really satisfied with just your current team?
Many Trainers raise multiple Pokémon-- more than six even--
And swap them out in rotation for their upcoming challenges.
Never consider your doors closed, friend.
We're still finishing up some loose ends on the Beryl Wall repair project, so hang tight!
Donations and reconstruction will be available again soon.
We value your interest in helping Reborn City, so we hope you'll check back shortly!
Hello! I accept donations for restoration projects on behalf of Reborn City.
Would you like to donate to one of our projects today?
why are you here lol
That's okay. I hope you'll consider it in the future!
\GFor the South Obsidia redevelopment, the remaining repair costs come to $\v[334].
How much will you donate?
That covers the project!
I'll let everyone know that it's been fully funded, and we'll set to work right away.
Look forward to it!
Thank you so much. Reborn City will be a better place for your contribution!
Um.
While I admire your zeal to help the city, you don't seem to have that much money on hand.
\GFor the Railnet reconstruction, the remaining repair costs come to $\v[335].
That's okay. I hope you consider it in the future!
\GFor the Azurine Island Nature Center, the remaining construction costs come to $\v[336].
By the way, since you are the sole proprietary founder for at least one project, we'd like to extend to you our warmest thanks!
Per policy, we invite you to meet the employees who work so hard with your money to keep this city thriving!
Our employee area is in the basement below here, and as a premier modern founder, you will now be permitted access at will to it.
All we ask is that you be courteous to the employees working there.
Thank you again for always looking out for Reborn City!
We're still finishing up some loose ends on our previous project, so hang tight!
Thank you for your continued generous donations to Reborn City!
Our next project, the Byxbysion Ward, will take much more time.
As it is still in the planning phase while we try to clear away the muck, it will probably be some time before we are ready to tackle it.
While I would not advise expecting it any time soon, I hope you can look forward to a bigger, brighter Reborn City in the future!
Of course, I recognize that you've been invaluable in helping us out here.
As an extra 'thank you', why don't you take this stone?
This was left behind after Ame--
Uh, well, I think she would have wanted you to have it.
So, please.
Let's look forward to a bigger, brighter Reborn City in the future.
Why doesn't anywhere sell Great Balls?! It's not fair!
I mean, the Obsidia Department Store does, but you need a lot of Stickers for that!
Maybe I should just learn to use the specialty balls from Critical Capture.
Shit, man. This stupid City Restoration Project went an' blasted the place I was using as shelter.
How the fuck they gonna do that? Who the fuck they helpin'?!
They think just cuz the damn roof's caving in and the walls got holes in 'em that that place ain't important to people?
They think we can afford their refurbished high-class estate housing?
Hell fuckin' nawh I can't!
They open up some full-on cheap-housing sector in Peridot, sayin' it's better quality than what I got.
I ain't about that bullshit! I want what I got! I want it back!
So Imma camp out here 'til I get my old lot back. We rebel in this shit.
Venturing outside the city is actually a nice change of pace.
I've heard Silph Co. is working on a way to make Pokémon that evolve by trade use a Stone instead.
Technology is truly amazing!
The city has had to spend an unprecedented amount of money in order to patch everything back up.
True, the vast majority of the work was done by volunteers who, thanks to Adrienn, showed up in droves.
But resources cost money, and we are well into debt by now.
Although I think we could have been a bit more frugal in our spending, I have no qualms.
One of the best ways Reborn can make money is by investing in our tourist industry. In order to do that, our city must be beautiful.
And soon, it certainly shall be.
Hey there! You wanna check out... The TMNS?!
You can't hide in your shell forever, you know!
What? You wanna go?
Didn't think so.
You don't know who I am. Care to find out?
That's okay. No one here does.
I'm going to play a little song. Can you keep up?
Very well...
Hey, c'mere for a sec! Can I ask you something really quickly?
Ooh, yay! Another person who wants to fight us~?
Let's go, dear!
Awwwwwwh.
Care for a battle? Talk to the lady if so.
Come at me, bro.
Weak.
They say you're at your best in your youth, but I feel like I'm at my best now! Try me, young'n!
What a shame. Anyone?!
I'm gonna rock, and you're gonna roll! Sound fair?
Then you roll on outta here.
Show me the true power of the bond between you and your Pokémon.
When you are ready.
Oh hello! It's a pleasure to meet you! Let's have a battle!
Maybe some other time!
Got a problem, pal?
AME: Oh, \PN. So Julia and Florinia found you after all.
I'm glad, though I'm kind of in the middle of something.
If there's anything you need to do since getting back, now would be a good time to do it.
Or are you waiting on me?
AME: Already? You move fast.
Okay, just a second, please.
AME: Sorry, as I was about to say, please inform Bennett that we accept.
He certainly did famously during the trial battle, but something feels weird about the situation.
Maybe I'm just hung up on Laura's resignation.
But the letter she sent was handwritten, signed, and unquestionably hers...
Well, whatever.
You can take care of the rest for me, right? Did you get his types?
SECRETARY: Yes. I'll register and notify him.
AME: Thank you.
All right. I've got a couple of other things to take care of, but I could use your help.
The most important thing is...
Well, before I explain, I should bring everyone here.
This might take all of us.
Adrienn, Victoria, and DJ Arclight are taking care of various things around the city.
I'm not exactly sure where they are right now,
But you know them, right? You can probably guess where to start.
Just tell them to come back here when you find them.  I'll be waiting.
AME: Great, you take care of whatever you need to, and come back to me once you're done!
AME: Adrienn, Victoria, and DJ Arclight are taking care of various things around the city.
AME: So Arclight is meeting us there?
Assuming he takes the low way, that should be all right.
VICTORIA: Sorry if I kept anyone waiting!
AME: Arclight's not coming here, but he already knows, so this is everyone.
VICTORIA: Is something going on?
AME: Here's the situation.
We received an anonymous tip that Team Meteor still has a base in the city, right under our noses.
ADRIENN: Devon?
VICTORIA: Devon?
AME: Devon.
How did you know?
ADRIENN: For my part, it's the only logical place left.
I've been all over the rest of the city pretty intimately, but Devon Corp. is the one place that's always restricted anyone from working around.
VICTORIA: Even the storefront just looks shifty for what's supposed to be an international company.
ADRIENN: Sweet Co. invested heavily in the restoration, and even Silph Co. was generous enough to donate funds.
The fact that Devon still refused after that also made me suspicious.
AME: Yes, well it's no longer just a suspicion or anonymous lead.
I took the liberty of calling Mr. Stone with a business inquiry regarding Devon's Reborn branch.
And of course, he informed me that no such thing exists.
VICTORIA: Then it's settled! We can shut it down for good!
AME: Before that, there's one more thing.
Our informant also told us that the leader of Team Meteor is hidden there right now.
VICTORIA: Solaris...
I won't hold back!
AME: No. It's Lin.
From what Saphira has told me, we can't take any chances with her.
That's why I need all of you.
And that's why I'm going too.
ADRIENN: Oh? I thought you said you intended to stay on the sidelines?
AME: It's true that Anna asked me to do that originally...
AME: It's true that I intended to do that originally...
But at this point,
If we can end all of this now,
I'll do whatever it takes.
Besides, as the Champion, I can't just do nothing, right?
Sorry, \PN, didn't you know?
It's not something I like to toss around or brag about.
But I did restart this League after all, and who did you think runs the trial battles for Leaders?
Anyway, it's really not important.
Right now, we need to focus on Devon Corp.
I've already talked over the details with Arclight, so here's the plan:
The main level is probably fairly secure, even if they don't want it to be seen.
So, we're going to take a pincer movement with one group in the front, and another approaching from the basement level which connects to the Railnet.
We'll rendezvous in the middle, and tackle the upper floors together.
Any questions?
ADRIENN: How are the groups decided?
AME: You and I will take the storefront.
If we pretend to be there on city restoration business, it won't be suspicious.
\PN, Victoria and Arclight will come up under and behind them.
ADRIENN: If we all work together, they don't stand a chance!
VICTORIA: I'll show Team Meteor the same mercy they showed Kiki.
AME: Then we're set.
Let's not waste any time!
ADRIENN: While we're waiting for the others, there's something I was curious about.
If I was gone for so long, why didn't you replace me?
Surely if the League was still going, you would have needed a new Fairy Leader.
AME: Um, the thing is...
I actually did replace you.
ADRIENN: Oh? I'd love to meet the new-- or rather, old-- Leader!
AME: Yeah, about that...
Nobody's seen or heard from him since the incident in Jasper Ward.
It seems pretty likely that he didn't make it.
Then, you came back before I finished arranging a replacement.
Nice timing in that regard.
ADRIENN: Ah, I'm sorry to have brought up something like that.
ADRIENN: The others should be here soon, right?
